questions.answer: D. It becomes nine times as large.

option_feedback.A: This treats kinetic energy as independent of speed, but speed is squared in E_K = 1/2 mv^2.

option_feedback.C: This multiplies by the factor 2 from the one-half coefficient, which is unchanged in the ratio.
option_feedback.D: Correct. With mass fixed, E_K is proportional to v^2, so the factor is 3^2 = 9.
